text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock D after its large gains reduced my concentration while letting me keep some exposure; I should base position sizing on risk and diversification, not assume its rise will continue.","A sale at a gain does not by itself prove the timing was right; with random price changes, I should avoid judging decisions by the next month's performance.","Because I trade rarely and losses weigh heavily on me, I should make deliberate portfolio reviews and avoid reacting impulsively to short-term account swings."]}
